controller.quote: We care about your privacy. When Mozilla (that’s us) collects information about you, our Mozilla Privacy Policy describes how we handle that information.

contact.quote: If you have any other questions regarding personal data or our privacy practices, please contact us at compliance@mozilla.com .

purposes.quote: We use this information to process and evaluate applications and to communicate with applicants about opportunities.

recipients.quote: Our email management vendors are SalesForce , Amazon Simple Email Service , Mailchimp , SocketLabs , Campaign Monitor , or Braze

retention.quote: We use Braze , Salesforce , Fundraise Up and Campaign Monitor to email receipts and store records, which are retained for 10 years from the date of last payment.

notes: controller is weak (no explicit controller term, just Mozilla as us). rights not listed (only 'data protection rights' mentioned). Retention only for donation records.
